title: Repair authoritative account provisioning boundary
verify: A focused adversarial boundary probe proves that only server-resolved actor plus own-center Admin authorization can reach the provisioning write.
The valid own-center Admin path creates the requested role-bearing account and one invitation; unauthenticated, non-Admin, and cross-center attempts leave persistence unchanged.
Duplicate, expired/revoked/reused, and induced-failure paths preserve account, role, membership, invitation, and binding state before/after; account and invitation roll back together.
A read-only public-surface probe proves no public createAccount or issueInvitation write bypass remains beside provisionAccount.

Independent /verify result: focused provisioning probe 4/4 passed; check/build/full test (2 files/8 tests)/diff-check passed; fresh evidence in .protocols/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/verification.md and .tasks/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2-S-VERIFY-final-report-docs-01.md; VERDICT: PASS.
evidence_required: FT-001-AC-005 RED: an unauthenticated, non-Admin, cross-center, caller-forged center/role, or alternate createAccount/issueInvitation call can write provisioning state; GREEN: each is rejected before Identity & Access persistence changes, while a valid own-center Admin succeeds; artifact: .tasks/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/ and .protocols/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/verification.md.

FT-001-AC-005 RED: duplicate or induced provisioning failure leaves only account or only invitation persisted; GREEN: account and invitation state is equal before/after rollback; artifact: .tasks/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/ and .protocols/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/verification.md.

FT-001-AC-003 RED: expired, revoked, reused, or duplicate identity/invitation paths mutate account, role, membership, invitation, or binding state; GREEN: each rejection preserves the state snapshot; artifact: .tasks/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/ and .protocols/TASK-015-T3-FT-001-W2/verification.md.
purpose: Restore the accepted Account Provisioning Boundary after TASK-003 exposed alternate unprotected public writes.
success_outcome: One server-authorized provisionAccount path creates account and invitation atomically; all unauthorized, alternate, duplicate, reuse, and rollback paths are denied without partial state.
anti_goals: Do not reuse TASK-003 evidence or change its failed lifecycle.
Do not trust caller-supplied role or center.
Do not expose public createAccount or issueInvitation provisioning writes.
Do not move membership writes out of Center & Scheduling or introduce a new architecture boundary.
constraints: Center & Scheduling resolves server-side actor and own-center Admin authorization before the Identity & Access write.
Identity & Access exclusively writes account, role, invitation, external identity, and session state.
Account and invitation creation is one atomic transaction.
Tests use isolated disposable state with safe rerun and cleanup; no credentials, network, or production database.
invariants: No caller-trusted center or role is used for authorization.
Only provisionAccount is the public provisioning write command.
Unauthenticated, non-Admin, and cross-center requests cannot create account or invitation state.
Rejected duplicate, reuse, and rollback paths leave state unchanged.
verification_targets: FT-001-AC-005: focused server-side matrix for unauthenticated, non-Admin, cross-center, valid own-center Admin, caller-forged scope, duplicate, and rollback cases with state-before/state-after snapshots.
